title: Piebald-AI/claude-code-system-prompts — Internal System Prompt Tracker
description: Repository tracking all of Claude Code's internal system prompts across 136+ versions since v2.0.14, updated with each release. Contains: main system prompt, 18 builtin tool descriptions, sub-agent prompts (Plan/Explore/Task), utility prompts (CLAUDE.md, compact, statusline, magic docs, WebFetch, Bash cmd, security review, agent creation). Maintained by Piebald-AI, updated to v2.1.87 as of March 28, 2026. Primary value: understanding what Claude Code 'knows' about itself by default so CLAUDE.md instructions can complement rather than duplicate built-in context.
redundancy_check: No existing capability in registry tracks Claude Code's internal system prompt evolution. This is a reference resource with no equivalent. NOT a duplicate.
integration_notes: Add to registry as reference resource under a 'Meta-Tooling / Internal Reference' section. Use when writing skills/agents to verify what context Claude already has built-in. Zero maintenance overhead — reference only.

evaluation.reasoning: This is a high-value zero-cost reference. Integration is a single registry entry — no code, no MCP, no configuration. The value is qualitative: when writing new skills or agents, consulting this repo reveals what Claude already knows by default, preventing instructions that duplicate built-in context or, worse, contradict it. The tracker covers v2.0.14 through v2.1.87 with per-version diffs, making it useful for understanding what changed in new releases (e.g., 'what tool descriptions changed in v2.1.84?'). Token efficiency is neutral — this is reference material consulted occasionally, not loaded into context. Capability expansion is incremental: it doesn't add a new tool, but it improves the quality of everything we write by grounding it in actual Claude Code behavior rather than assumptions. Maintenance burden is minimal — Piebald-AI maintains the repo independently. Community validation at 70 reflects active maintenance (updated 2 days ago to v2.1.87) by a credible tracker, though not official Anthropic.
evaluation.action: REGISTRY_UPDATE: Add 'Piebald-AI/claude-code-system-prompts' to registry/existing-capabilities.md under a new 'Meta-Tooling / Reference' section. Note: consult when writing new skills/agents to avoid duplicating or contradicting built-in system prompt context.
